Our Story

Do the job right the first time.

Trotta Construction Group was founded on one simple principle: do the job right the first time. With years of hands-on experience in residential construction, we build to last — with honest pricing and no shortcuts.

We believe in strong customer relationships. That's why communication, transparency, and craftsmanship are core to everything we do, from the first estimate to the final walkthrough.

Quality Craftsmanship

Precise work, finished the way it should be — every time.

Safety

A safe job site for our crew, our clients, and every neighbor around it.

Integrity & Accountability

We say what we mean, and we stand behind the work we do.

Respect for Our Clients' Time and Budget

Realistic timelines and straight numbers, from quote to completion.
